intro.narration: [excited] Is three thousand nine hundred five divisible by four? Two seconds, no long division.

steps.narration: [confident] The trick? Only the last two digits matter. So just look at oh five.
steps.instruction: Only the last two digits matter

steps.narration: [thoughtful] Divide those by four. Five over four is one, remainder one.
[confident] There's a remainder, so the answer is no.

outro.narration: [warm] Try it on any big number. Just check the last two.
outro.display: Try it on any big number.
